title: My Cousin Gave Me 50 Five-Star Reviews!

lines.text: Fifty five-star reviews overnight! My cousin deserves a medal!
He made 50 accounts! Look at that perfect rating!
lines.why: still celebrating as the counter slips 50 → 48 → 42 → 35

lines.text: Wait... why are my reviews decreasing?!

lines.why: 1.3 s of complete silence, then the Review Bot rolls in

lines.text: Review check complete. Those reviews were fake.
Five stars don't make 50 fake accounts real.
That's not customer feedback. That's your cousin's fan club.
Google can remove fake reviews, and your Business Profile may face restrictions.
So... how am I supposed to get reviews now?
Want real reviews? Ask genuine customers for honest feedback. No rewards, no pressure, and no asking only happy customers.
So... actual customers. What a concept.
Apparently, customers are involved in customer reviews.

omitted.text: Fake and incentivized Google reviews violate Google's policies. They may be removed, and business profiles can face restrictions.
